== Summary ==
PC Errata 2016 disc card image of [[Demotion (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]]: PC Errata 2016 disc card (Players Committee card image with a bronze disc mark, starwarsccg.org card lists).

Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/demotion.gif demotion.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806172109/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/demotion.gif Internet Archive] (6 August 2016, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 8 November 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261108171435/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/demotion.gif Internet Archive].

Uploaded unchanged (SHA-1 <code>75bd02143ee46fcf229aea09dc8e19baf4b0d3ff</code>).
